subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should crawl-remote production deployment be permanently authorized through vincentkoc’s immutable actor ID plus the crawl-remote-production protected environment?
rationale: Source review establishes that the workflow enforces this boundary, but only repository owners can approve the intended production operator, backup access, and recovery policy.

options.title: Approve current defense in depth
options.body: Retain the immutable actor gate and require protected-environment approval for every production deployment.

options.title: Define a maintainer operator team
options.body: Replace the single named dispatcher with a documented, auditable team authorization model before production use.

recommendation.title: Approve current defense in depth
recommendation.body: Retain the immutable actor gate and require protected-environment approval for every production deployment.

likelyOwner.reason: The long-running workflow owner is the strongest routing candidate for the permanent production authorization policy.
